rows.quote: Based on the above criteria, 16 GWAS datasets of outcome traits were selected from the MRC IEU OpenGWAS database, comprising datasets of AD from Alzheimer Disease Genetics Consortium (ADGC), Cohorts for Heart and Aging Research in Genomic Epidemiology Consortium (CHARGE), The European Alzheimer’s Disease Initiative (EADI), and Genetic and Environmental Risk in AD/Defining Genetic, Polygenic and Environmental Risk for Alzheimer’s Disease Consortium (GERAD/PERADES) 2019 (ieu-b-2); AD from Benjamin Woolf 2022 (ieu-b-5067); AD from International Genomics of Alzheimer’s Project (IGAP) 2013 (ieu-a-297) as the datasets of main outcome traits for AD, as well as 13 datasets from FinnGen biobank 2021 corresponding to various AD subtypes, referred to as AD-finn subtypes (as shown in Figure 5).
rows.dataset_named_in_source: datasets of AD from Alzheimer Disease Genetics Consortium (ADGC), Cohorts for Heart and Aging Research in Genomic Epidemiology Consortium (CHARGE), The European Alzheimer’s Disease Initiative (EADI), and Genetic and Environmental Risk in AD/Defining Genetic, Polygenic and Environmental Risk for Alzheimer’s Disease Consortium (GERAD/PERADES) 2019 (ieu-b-2); AD from Benjamin Woolf 2022 (ieu-b-5067); AD from International Genomics of Alzheimer’s Project (IGAP) 2013 (ieu-a-297)
rows.coder_note: The outcome datasets are named by OpenGWAS accession (ieu-b-2, ieu-b-5067, ieu-a-297) plus 13 unnumbered 'FinnGen biobank 2021' datasets; no dictionary row lists any of these accessions (rules B, G), and the row stands for several datasets, so no single dictionary row is identified.

The exposure datasets are described only as selected from the 42,335 GWAS datasets of the MRC IEU OpenGWAS database (Elsworth et al., 2020, the database infrastructure); no pQTL study, accession, platform or sample size is given in the passages.
